title: Jobs of one class run one at a time in submit order and the rest in parallel, and a job whose lock another process holds waits as waiting-lock
goal: kj_exec.next_runnable(jobs, running, holders, slots) returns (run, wait) for the queued jobs: land jobs of one clone run one at a time (the clone's landing lock), sync-push jobs of a host one at a time (the host main lock kb-main.lock), a check tests-full job one at a time per host (the test lock), done and stage-back jobs one at a time per item, every other pair in parallel up to slots (default 3, serve --parallel N); a job whose class has a lock holder outside the executor (a session's own land or sync run by hand: pid, clone and step read from the lock file as bl_procs.lock_holders does) is not started but moved to waiting-lock with the holder's pid, clone and step in its event, and starts when the lock is free, so no child burns the 1800 s main-lock wait; kj_exec.lock_holders() reads the host's lock files; submit order is the order inside one class

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kj_exec; J=lambda i,op,sub,**o: {"job":i,"op":op,"subject":sub,"options":o,"state":"queued","clone":"c1"}; jobs=[J("a","land","ST-1"),J("b","land","ST-2"),J("c","done","ST-3"),J("d","stage-back","ST-3"),J("e","sync-push",""),J("f","check","",name="tests-full")]; run,wait=kj_exec.next_runnable(jobs,running=[],holders={},slots=3); assert [j["job"] for j in run]==["a","c","e"], run; run,wait=kj_exec.next_runnable(jobs[4:5],running=[],holders={"host-main":{"pid":1,"clone":"c2","step":"push"}},slots=3); assert run==[] and wait[0][0]["job"]=="e" and wait[0][2]["pid"]==1, (run,wait)

import sys,os,tempfile; os.environ["KB_HOST_LOCK_DIR"]=tempfile.mkdtemp(); sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kg_lock, kj_exec; assert kj_exec.lock_holders().get("host-main") is None; cm=kg_lock.main_lock("plant"); cm.__enter__(); h=kj_exec.lock_holders(); cm.__exit__(None,None,None); assert h["host-main"]["pid"]==os.getpid() and h["host-main"]["step"]=="plant", h

clauses.clause: kj_exec.next_runnable(jobs, running, holders, slots) returns (run, wait) for the queued jobs: land jobs of one clone run one at a time (the clone's landing lock), sync-push jobs of a host one at a time (the host main lock kb-main.lock), a check tests-full job one at a time per host (the test lock), done and stage-back jobs one at a time per item, every other pair in parallel up to slots (default 3, serve --parallel N)

a job whose class has a lock holder outside the executor (a session's own land or sync run by hand: pid, clone and step read from the lock file as bl_procs.lock_holders does) is not started but moved to waiting-lock with the holder's pid, clone and step in its event
starts when the lock is free, so no child burns the 1800 s main-lock wait
kj_exec.lock_holders() reads the host's lock files
submit order is the order inside one class

notes: Rules read from the code and docs: landings of one clone run one at a time under kb-landing.lock in the git common directory (bl_close.landing_lock, bl_close.py:376, git.md:64); every step that moves the integration main holds kb-main.lock in the host lock directory (kg_lock.main_lock, kg_lock.py:141; sync --push for its whole run, land's fetch and rebase; git.md:62), wait bound 1800 s then MainLockTimeout; the whole-suite tests.py takes the host test lock (kb-tests.lock, coordination.md:207); order main lock first, test lock second (LockOrderError). The executor never takes these locks itself: the CLI it runs does, so the rules stay in one place and a hand-run land in a session still serialises with the executor's. The queue's job is order and visibility: without it N submitted lands would start N processes that all wait on the landing lock and burn its bound (ST-igkt3vsr already notes land --wait-merge does not count that wait). Parallel-safe by the table: done or stage-back of different items (the run-state table refuses same-item overlap, coordination.md:56), check selections (no lock), a land of another clone. slots default 3 is the one tunable; a host under load keeps the 29 s test ceiling by the lock, not by the slots. Check is pure on planted lists plus one real lock plant in a temporary KB_HOST_LOCK_DIR; the check never submits sync-push or land, so no check can push.
